name: Mariam of Cambay
bio: Mariam leases a dry storeroom for the Nur's glassware and holds a share in the Malabar pepper cargo. She will recount broken flasks herself before she asks anyone to make good the loss.
notes: inference: A resident factor arranging dry storage for imported glass is a plausible trading role, not a documented appointment for this character (docs/research/commodities.md, Glassware; docs/research/port-official.md, Warehousing)

gameplay: The Nur is a Cambay nau carrying glass beads and empty flasks. Mariam stays ashore and finances a share of the day-one Malabar pepper run without owning its vessel (data/briefings/day_01_turn_of_the_monsoon.json; data/briefings/day_04_rumours_from_the_west.json)

gameplay: Give her a reliable place to store glass and she advances flasks to the rosewater trade; break a promise on storage and she lets Ratri's buyers take the pepper instead of reserving it for Lin Wen (docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§08–09)
